dates.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-06-02
dates.summary:
**DeepMind’s origin story gets sharper**: Demis Hassabis’s biographer frames the AI race as inevitable, with safety now looking like a government-enforced coordination problem; **agentic coding goes mainstream and weird**: Codex gets farm jokes, voice nudges, worktrees, cross-model review, and always-on goal swarms; **model economics are heating up**: MiniMax M3 is pitched as an open-model contender near Opus and GPT-5 at a fraction of the cost; **enterprise AI advantage shifts from models to proprietary workflows**: Box’s Aaron Levie argues the moat is institutional knowledge plus data plus domain process.

**DeepMind 往事更锋利了**：Demis Hassabis 传记作者把 AI 竞赛说成几乎不可避免，安全问题更像要靠政府强制协调；**代码智能体正在变得又主流又怪**：Codex 被拿来开农场玩笑、语音催人解锁、配合 worktree、跨模型审查和常驻 /goal；**模型价格战继续升温**：MiniMax M3 被推到开放模型前排，号称接近 Opus 和 GPT-5、成本低很多；**企业 AI 护城河从模型转向自有流程**：Box 的 Aaron Levie 认为关键是把机构知识、数据和行业工作流接进 AI。

dates.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-05-31
dates.summary:
English: Today’s snapshot covers **Claude Managed Agents** adding dreaming, outcomes, orchestration, and webhooks; **Gemini** co-lead Oriol Vinyals on world models, multimodal learning, RL, memory, and robotics; plus builder posts on **Codex**, **GPT-5.5**, **Vercel AI Gateway**, **Cursor** auto-review, AI education, enterprise AI investment, and California politics.

中文：今天的快照包括 **Claude Managed Agents** 新增 dreaming、outcomes、多智能体编排和 webhooks；**Gemini** 联合负责人 Oriol Vinyals 谈世界模型、多模态学习、RL、记忆和机器人；以及关于 **Codex**、**GPT-5.5**、**Vercel AI Gateway**、**Cursor** auto-review、AI 教育、企业 AI 投入和加州政治的 builder 动态。
